org: Department of Early Education and Care / Mass211
whatThisIs: [Massachusetts by way of EEC offers financial assistance to help families pay for childcare. Due to budget constraints however once you apply you will be added to a waitlist. If you require application help or to ask questions not covered by the EEC, Mass211 can help screen families for eligibility and locate childcare providers near you. The Application for Child Care Financial Assistance itself is run through EEC and can be completed online once an account with them is made. If accepted you can then find a childcare provider who will accept the voucher, and pay for childcare at a much lower cost if at all.]
whoItHelps: [Families and Parents looking for financial help with childcare]
whatToKnow: Due to waitlists, aid is not guaranteed on a set timeline, there is currently no released document sharing average waiting times.
Parent DO NOT have to offer proof of citizenship to apply, only the child must show documentation of citizenship or be a qualified non-citizens
name: Info Panel - Child Care Financial Assistance
